Good question. You actually don’t need to pair it with much to get great results.
Your easyplant already comes with slow-release fertilizer in the soil, so it’s set for about the first 12 months. After that, you can add a liquid houseplant fertilizer diluted to about 1/4 strength when refilling the reservoir.
The only other thing you might use later is a small top-up of coco coir or a light indoor potting mix if the soil settles over time.
So in short: the plant is ready to go, and you only add fertilizer after a year if you want a growth boost.
